annotation.title_clean: 動力車操縦者運転免許に関する省令
annotation.title_en: Ministerial Ordinance on Driver's Licenses for Power Vehicle Operators
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism (formerly Ministry of Transport), Japan
annotation.summary_en: Japanese ministerial ordinance (1956, current revision effective 1 Oct 2026) establishing the licensing system for human operators of railway, tramway and trolleybus power vehicles, covering license types, examinations, designated training institutions, license reissue and fees. It aims to improve operator quality and ensure transport safety; it contains no AI or robotics provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Operators must hold a Regional Transport Bureau license before driving railway, tramway or trolleybus power vehicles.
Licenses are issued by type and may carry conditions; they can be revoked or suspended for violations.
Examinations cover physical, aptitude, written and practical skill tests, with exemptions for certain qualifications.
Training institutes are designated by the Minister and subject to reporting, audit, improvement orders and revocation.
Fees are set for license application and reissuance.
